acceptance_checks.then: every palette token whose manifest role is `content` SHALL reach a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against each declared background it is used on
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the palette contrast unit test enumerates every (token, background) pair in which a `content`-role token is used across the declared-background set -- cream, light, parchment-dark, and the hero gradient stops `#211C30`/`#312A45` -- and asserts every pair is >= 4.5 without rounding; the test fails if the `content` set is empty

acceptance_checks.then: every meaning-bearing non-text boundary SHALL reach a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against its adjacent colour
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the palette contrast test asserts the stat-bar track hairline and fill-edge tokens are >= 3:1 against the adjacent surface without rounding

acceptance_checks.then: each character-sheet HP, MP, and ST bar SHALL expose `role="meter"` carrying `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, and `aria-valuetext`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: axe run on the About page reports each HP/MP/ST bar with role meter and a non-empty aria-valuetext such as "85 of 100 hit points"

acceptance_checks.then: the EXP bar SHALL expose `role="progressbar"` rather than `role="meter"`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: axe run on the About page reports the EXP bar with role progressbar and the required aria-value attributes

acceptance_checks.given: a project rendered with a rarity tier
acceptance_checks.then: the tier SHALL be conveyed by a visible text label, never by chip colour alone
acceptance_checks.verify_method: each rarity chip in `_site` contains the tier word as text; Color Oracle simulation confirms tiers remain distinguishable without hue

acceptance_checks.given: any auto-starting animation presented in parallel with other content on any page
acceptance_checks.when: the page is loaded with no motion preference expressed
acceptance_checks.then: the animation SHALL complete within five seconds rather than loop indefinitely
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rn "infinite" _sass/ assets/js/` returns zero hits outside a `--motionOK` gated block; each remaining animation declares a finite duration <= 5s and a non-infinite iteration count

acceptance_checks.then: every purely decorative SVG ornament SHALL be hidden from assistive technology by exactly one method
acceptance_checks.verify_method: each ornament SVG root carries `aria-hidden="true"` and no ornament carries both `aria-hidden` and an empty `alt`

acceptance_checks.then: every themed navigation item SHALL expose an accessible name that contains its visible themed label
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the accessible name for the Notebook link contains the string "Notebook"; axe reports no label-in-name violation

acceptance_checks.given: a fluid type rule expressed with `clamp()`
acceptance_checks.then: its maximum value SHALL be no more than 2.5 times its minimum value
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script parses every `clamp()` in `_sass/` and asserts max/min <= 2.5

acceptance_checks.when: it is viewed at a viewport width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels
acceptance_checks.then: the content SHALL reflow without requiring scrolling in two dimensions
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a 320px-wide render of Home, About, and one post shows no horizontal scrollbar

acceptance_checks.then: its focus indicator SHALL remain visible and not be entirely obscured by the fixed sidebar or sticky chrome
acceptance_checks.verify_method: keyboard walk of Home, About, and one post shows a visible focus ring on every interactive element with no element hidden behind the 60px sidebar

acceptance_checks.then: every pointer target SHALL present a hit area of at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or satisfy the 24px spacing exception
acceptance_checks.verify_method: axe target-size check reports zero violations across the sigil nav and social icon row

acceptance_checks.given: a themed chip, badge, banner, or stat row
acceptance_checks.when: a user overrides text spacing to the 1.4.12 values
acceptance_checks.then: no text SHALL be clipped by a fixed height
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rnE '(^|[^-[:alnum:]])height:[[:space:]]*[0-9]' _sass/` returns zero hits within themed chip, badge, banner, or stat-row rule blocks (this pattern excludes `min-height`/`max-height`/`line-height`); the text-spacing bookmarklet clips nothing

acceptance_checks.then: the continuous-integration pipeline SHALL fail the build when any sitemap URL reports a WCAG 2.2 AA violation
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `pa11y-ci` with the axe runner and `standard: WCAG2AA` runs over the sitemap in GitHub Actions and exits non-zero on any violation

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish an `/accessibility` page stating the conformance target and the known gaps
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/accessibility/` renders and names WCAG 2.2 AA, the automated axe check, and a contact route for reports

acceptance_checks.given: a palette token referenced by a CSS `color`, `border-color`, or `fill` rule that renders body text or a meaning-bearing boundary, and whose manifest role is not `logotype`
acceptance_checks.when: the token classification manifest is applied
acceptance_checks.then: that token SHALL carry manifest role `content` with obligation `ink`, resolving to an `-ink` token rather than an `-ornament` one
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script cross-references every token usage in `_sass/` against the manifest and asserts every non-`logotype` body-text or meaning-bearing-boundary usage resolves to a token whose role is `content` and obligation is `ink`; zero such usages resolve to an `ornament` or `exempt` token

acceptance_checks.then: the repository SHALL carry a committed manifest assigning every palette token exactly one `role` from ornament, logotype, or content together with exactly one `obligation` from ink or exempt, under the mapping in which `content` takes `ink` while `ornament` and `logotype` take `exempt`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a committed manifest enumerates every token declared in `_sass/_variables.scss` with exactly one role and one obligation each; zero tokens are unclassified; a script asserts that role `content` holds if and only if obligation `ink` for every row, and asserts that every `logotype`-role token is referenced only by rules inside the wordmark selector set (`.hero-subtitle` in `_home.scss` and `_about.scss`) and by no rule that renders body text

acceptance_checks.then: the palette contrast test SHALL run as a blocking continuous-integration check from the first accessibility release onward
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the CI workflow invokes the palette contrast test and exits non-zero on any failing token; the check is present in the same release that ships the ink token split

acceptance_checks.given: a fluid type rule expressed with `clamp()`
acceptance_checks.then: that middle term SHALL carry a `rem` or `px` component rather than a viewport unit alone
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script parses every `clamp()` in `_sass/` and asserts each middle term matches a `rem` or `px` component; zero `vw`-only middle terms remain
